from fastapi_cli.config import FastAPIConfig
from fastapi_cli.discover import get_import_data, get_import_data_from_import_string
from uvicorn.importer import import_from_string
from starlette.testclient import TestClient
config = FastAPIConfig.resolve()
data = get_import_data_from_import_string(config.entrypoint, config.from_pyproject) if config.entrypoint else get_import_data()
client = TestClient(import_from_string(data.import_string), raise_server_exceptions=False, follow_redirects=False)
for path in ('/typed/7', '/typed/a', '/files/a', '/files/a/b', '/slug/a-b', '/slug/a/b', '/pair/a/b', '/pair/a', '/two/1/2', '/two/1',
             '/glued/x-y', '/strict/', '/strict', '/loose', '/loose/', '/api/users/7', '/api/users/7/8', '/api/users/embedded/leaf',
             '/api/embedded/leaf',
             '/t/acme/info', '/t/acme/b/info', '/sub/hello', '/static/hello.txt'):
    response = client.get(path)
    print(path, '->', response.status_code, response.headers.get('location', ''))
